svg.aria-label: Architecture: Airflow DAGs (through airflow_adapter.py, the only Airflow import), the dp command and pytest all call runner.run_task, which writes every task of every run to platform.run_log and runs the pipeline's tasks (LoadCsv, CopyQuery, RunSql, Upsert, Scd2, QualityChecks). Tasks reach data only through the ports.py interfaces: Warehouse (DuckDB, PostgreSQL or Redshift adapter) and ObjectStore (a local folder, or S3, GCS and Azure through fsspec).

Tasks reach data only through the ports.py interfaces: Warehouse (DuckDB, PostgreSQL or Redshift adapter) and ObjectStore (a local folder, or S3, GCS and Azure through fsspec).
